meta.listSource: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026, via the competition kit
meta.note: Seven trophies are unconfirmed: their guides say so honestly instead of inventing steps.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn every other trophy in the game. There is no shortcut: the platinum unlocks automatically the moment the 54th trophy pops. Follow the roadmap in order — story first, then the 100% cleanup, then the Strangers & Freaks strands — and keep the single missable trophy, Positive Mental Attitude, in mind from Chapter 1. Sources: PowerPyx, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the story mission Gone Fishing and finish it. It is an early story mission; follow the on-screen objectives to the end of the mission and the trophy pops at the results screen. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1. The trophy unlocks when the final Chapter 1 mission ends and the Chapter 2 title card appears. Do the Positive Mental Attitude meditation on Lucia's balcony before you leave Chapter 1, because that spot cannot be revisited. Sources: PowerPyx, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2. The trophy pops when the last Chapter 2 mission completes and the story moves into Chapter 3. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3. The trophy unlocks at the end of the chapter's final mission, when the story transitions to Chapter 4. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4. The trophy pops when the chapter's final mission ends and the story moves into the finale. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the game's final story mission. It unlocks after Chapter 4; finish its objectives and watch the credits roll, and the gold trophy pops. Make sure you have done the missable Positive Mental Attitude meditation long before this point. Sources: PowerPyx, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Follow the mission markers, finish the delivery run, and the trophy unlocks at the mission results screen. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It is a heist mission: complete the setup and the heist itself, escape with the crew, and the trophy pops when the mission ends. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Follow the objectives through to the end of the mission and the trophy unlocks at the results screen. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Finish the mission's objectives and the trophy pops when the mission completes. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. It is an airport takedown mission at VCIA; complete the objectives, escape the area, and the trophy unlocks at the mission end. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Finish the operation's objectives and the trophy pops when the mission ends. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion in the game's stats. That means finishing the story, all Strangers & Freaks strands, every collectible set, all activities and challenges, and every side objective the game counts. Use the in-game stats page to find what is missing; the last few percent are usually collectibles or stunt jumps. Sources: PowerPyx, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts are the game's stunt jumps and air tricks: hit the marked stunt jumps across Leonida, land cleanly, and each one counts. The counter is cumulative, so spread them across the whole map and revisit areas as you unlock them. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every type of side activity at least once: racing, fishing, the shooting range, arcade games, drone races, bowling, and the rest. You only need to attempt each type once, not win or finish it. Work through the activities menu and tick each type off as you try it. Sources: PowerPyx, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge. Visit the shooting range, work through each weapon challenge, and hit the gold score threshold on all of them. Use a steady aim, control recoil, and replay a challenge as many times as needed — the gold medal is per challenge, not per run. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every race location. Fly the drone through the checkpoints, beat the target time at each location, and the trophy pops once you have won at all of them. Learn each course's line before going for the win. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Each distinct race event counts once, so you need 20 separate race wins across the map — street races, off-road, boat and air races all count as long as each is a different event. Keep a fast car tuned and work through the race list. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at a fishing spot, accept his challenge, and out-fish him: hook more or bigger fish than he does before the timer ends. Use the best bait for the spot and keep your line tension in the green zone. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any arcade game. Walk into an arcade, pick a machine, and play it through to the end — finishing one full game is enough, you do not need a high score. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Andy's Strangers & Freaks strand. Find Andy's strand marker, work through all of his missions in order, and finish the last one. The trophy pops at the end of that final mission. Sources: PowerPyx, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Kenton's Strangers & Freaks strand. Work through Kenton's missions in order and finish the last one to unlock this trophy. Sources: PowerPyx, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Billy's Strangers & Freaks strand. Follow Billy's strand through all its missions and finish the last one. Sources: PowerPyx, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full Strangers & Freaks mission strands across Leonida. Each stranger has a chain of missions marked on the map; finish all missions in a strand to count it. You need 8 complete strands, including Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone. Sources: PowerPyx, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Randy's Strangers & Freaks strand. Work through Randy's missions in order and finish the last one. Sources: PowerPyx, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Tyrone's Strangers & Freaks strand. Follow Tyrone's strand through all its missions and finish the last one. Sources: PowerPyx, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida. This is the game's only missable trophy: the first spot is Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1, and that spot cannot be revisited once you leave Chapter 1, so do it before the chapter ends. After that, find and meditate at each remaining spot around the map — the game marks them once you have found the first one. Do not use cheats at any point, as they disable trophies. Sources: PowerPyx, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Find Bret, accept his hunting request, track the marked unique animal in the wild, and bring it down. Use a scoped rifle and approach from downwind so it does not flee. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida in shops, houses and hidden spots; each set needs every card in it. Collect all cards of three complete sets — use the in-game collection tracker to see which cards you are missing and where they are. Sources: PowerPyx, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK feature at 100 different locations. WAiNK is the in-game phone camera mode: open it at a landmark, snap the shot, and it counts that location. Work through the map region by region so you do not miss spots, and check the counter in the app to see your progress. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the game's repeatable feats — driving, shooting, flying, and miscellaneous tasks listed in the challenges menu. Work through the list and finish any 50; the easiest ones are the early driving and shooting challenges. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star Wanted Level, then lose the cops and escape. Get the police to 4 stars while your partner is in the car or on foot with you, then break line of sight, hide until the stars blink, and stay out of sight until the Wanted Level clears. Doing it in a fast car in the countryside makes the escape easier. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner while keeping your Wanted Level the whole time. Bring your partner, rob a shop, then immediately rob a second and a third without letting the Wanted Level drop to zero between them. Use shops close together and a getaway car parked outside. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Getting into a vehicle you have never driven counts as discovering it. Drive everything you see — cars, bikes, trucks, boats and aircraft — and check the vehicle log to see what you are missing. Rare vehicles spawn in specific districts. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus when a group of enemies is close together, and chain your shots so all 5 go down before the focus ends. A crowded shootout with a fast-firing weapon makes this much easier. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, the Vice City airport. Get onto the airfield, board a plane that is not part of a mission, and take off. You will need to get past airport security and the police response, so bring a fast approach and take off as soon as you are in the cockpit. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: UNVERIFIED: no published guide has confirmed how this trophy unlocks. The description points to the Rhino tank, but the exact trigger — whether it is driving a Rhino, surviving in one, or completing a specific feat with it — has not been verified by any guide at the time of writing. Do not rely on a guessed method; check the cited guides for an update before attempting it. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Enter quietly, avoid the cameras and the staff's line of sight, take the goods, and leave before any alarm is raised. Move slowly, stay out of the camera cones, and do not draw a weapon. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Plan each vault robbery, get in, crack the vault, and escape the police response. You need 5 separate successful vault robberies; the counter is cumulative, so you can do them one at a time across the game. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Find a truck on its route, stop it, break it open, take the cash, and lose the police. Blocking the truck with your own vehicle works well; be ready to run the moment the doors open. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Visit every named region and district on the map until the whole state is revealed. Drive, fly and sail through the areas you have not visited; the map fills in as you go, and the trophy pops when the last region is discovered. Sources: PowerPyx, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang. Each gang runs hidden operations around Leonida; find one per gang, raid it, and take the goods. You need one operation per gang, so work through the gang territories one at a time. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: UNVERIFIED: no published guide has confirmed how this trophy unlocks. The description suggests having a cocktail at a bar with a view on Ocean Beach, but which bar, which drink, and what exact interaction triggers it have not been verified by any guide at the time of writing. Do not rely on a guessed method; check the cited guides for an update before attempting it. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car into a showroom, then floor it through the front window and out onto the street, just like the classic scene. Any showroom with a glass front works; pick up speed inside and aim for the glass. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play a full game at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through. Go to the alley, start a game, and bowl all frames to the end — the follow-through is part of completing the game, not a single throw. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: UNVERIFIED: no published guide has confirmed how this trophy unlocks. The description hints at a partnership that gains mass appeal, but what partnership, what action, and what threshold count have not been verified by any guide at the time of writing. Do not rely on a guessed method; check the cited guides for an update before attempting it. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: UNVERIFIED: no published guide has confirmed how this trophy unlocks. The description points to making choices, but which choices, in which missions, and what outcome triggers it have not been verified by any guide at the time of writing. Do not rely on a guessed method; check the cited guides for an update before attempting it. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: UNVERIFIED: no published guide has confirmed how this trophy unlocks. The description suggests trying something a second time, but what activity, what failure, and what second attempt count have not been verified by any guide at the time of writing. Do not rely on a guessed method; check the cited guides for an update before attempting it. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: UNVERIFIED: no published guide has confirmed how this trophy unlocks. The description reads like a random or easter-egg event, but where it happens, what triggers it, and whether it is tied to a specific place or time have not been verified by any guide at the time of writing. Do not rely on a guessed method; check the cited guides for an update before attempting it. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: UNVERIFIED: no published guide has confirmed how this trophy unlocks. The description points to a melee drive-by involving bowling pins, but where, with what weapon, and how many targets count have not been verified by any guide at the time of writing. Do not rely on a guessed method; check the cited guides for an update before attempting it. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists; take them to a contact who launders them, and the clean money counts toward the total. Keep laundering until the cumulative $250,000 is reached — it does not need to be in one go. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, weapons, car parts, food and anything else the shops sell; the total is cumulative across every shop, so just keep buying as you play. Expensive items like high-end cars and weapons get you there fastest. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Garages are for sale around Leonida; buy every one of them. You will need a lot of cash, so do this late in the game after the big heists. Check the property list to see which garages you still need. Sources: PowerPyx, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the app on your phone, add a vehicle you own or have found, and repeat until 10 are registered. Any 10 vehicles count, so use the ones you already drive. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.
